type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: ci: kernel-check BSD material delta contract
formalize fail-closed BSD rank and refined material deltas

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: BSDMaterial.assemble
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Scalar : Type} {D : BSDMaterial.BSDDatum Scalar},   BSDMaterial.RankDelta D → BSDMaterial.RefinedDelta D → BSDMaterial.BSDEndpoint D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: BSDMaterial.endpoint_iff_deltas
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Scalar : Type} (D : BSDMaterial.BSDDatum Scalar),   BSDMaterial.BSDEndpoint D ↔ Nonempty (BSDMaterial.RankDelta D) ∧ Nonempty (BSDMaterial.RefinedDelta D)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: BSDMaterial.rank_projection
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Scalar : Type} {D : BSDMaterial.BSDDatum Scalar}, BSDMaterial.BSDEndpoint D → Nonempty (BSDMaterial.RankDelta D)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: BSDMaterial.refined_projection
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {Scalar : Type} {D : BSDMaterial.BSDDatum Scalar}, BSDMaterial.BSDEndpoint D → Nonempty (BSDMaterial.RefinedDelta D)
